semantic_method: Read all 66 original baseline PDF pages, inspect selected rendered ambiguity pages, manually group by meaning, retain prose permissions and exceptions, and mechanically reproduce indexed quotations.
quotation_policy: Exact indexed text with indexed normalization/correction policy; raw extraction stays in source_index.jsonl. Every period is an extraction boundary, including abbreviations and section numbers.
proof_policy: One proposed encompassing top-level Lean theorem per group. No Lean code or proofs are constructed.
force_policy: T=O is required when applicable; Threshold/Objective alternatives are choices; Optional objectives are not universally mandatory; unlabeled prose retains its own wording and may impose obligations.
definitions_policy: Context passages and Appendix A background units remain shared references; quoted descriptive clauses do not become unconditional mandates merely because they occur in a group.

source_units.text: The Commercial Solutions for Classified (CSfC) program within the National Security Agency’s (NSA’s) Cybersecurity Directorate (CSD) publishes Capability Packages (CPs) to provide configurations that allow customers to independently implement secure solutions using layered Commercial Off-the-Shelf (COTS) products.
source_units.reason: Program introduction and scope motivation; no additional standalone obligation beyond the grouped CP requirements.

source_units.text: The CPs are vendor-agnostic and provide high-level security and configuration guidance for customers and/or Solution Integrators.
source_units.reason: Program introduction and scope motivation; no additional standalone obligation beyond the grouped CP requirements.

source_units.text: The NSA delivers the CSfC Multi-Site Connectivity (MSC) CP to meet the demand for data-in-transit solutions using approved cryptographic algorithms and National Information Assurance Partnership (NIAP) evaluated components.
source_units.reason: Program introduction and scope motivation; no additional standalone obligation beyond the grouped CP requirements.

source_units.text: These algorithms, known as the Commercial National Security Algorithm (CNSA) Suite, are used to protect classified data using layers of COTS products.
